name: v22_ebitda_guidance_band_quality
hypothesis: A narrower EBITDA guidance range relative to enterprise value may indicate better management visibility and lower forecast uncertainty.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(max_ebitda_guidance - min_ebitda_guidance) / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(max_ebitda_guidance / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)

name: v22_pretax_guidance_band_quality
hypothesis: A narrower pretax-profit guidance band with higher upper guidance may indicate earnings visibility outside the existing EPS-yield family.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(max_pretax_profit_guidance - min_pretax_profit_guidance) / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(max_pretax_profit_guidance / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Pretax guidance variant; compare with EBITDA guidance before expanding.

name: v22_capex_guidance_discipline
hypothesis: Lower maximum capex guidance relative to assets, when not paired with ROE/CFO, may capture planned investment discipline distinct from historical capex.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * max_capital_expenditure_guidance / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(max_capital_expenditure_guidance - min_capital_expenditure_guidance) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Guided capex, not historical capex; strict corr gate against MPp7RPxn.

name: v22_sga_guidance_discipline
hypothesis: Lower maximum SG&A guidance relative to sales may proxy management cost discipline and operating leverage.
expression: 0.70 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * max_selling_general_admin_guidance / sales, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(max_ebitda_guidance / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Cost-guidance discipline; watch whether it becomes a generic quality proxy.

name: v22_core_earnings_yield
hypothesis: Higher S&P core earnings relative to enterprise value may capture cleaner earnings quality distinct from analyst EPS yield.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newqv1300_spcep12 / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_pncepsq), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: S&P core earnings 12MM; strict corr gate against EBITDA/EV and EPS-yield actives.

name: v22_core_eps_pension_clean
hypothesis: Core EPS is more useful when pension adjustment magnitude is low, reducing accounting adjustment noise.
notes: Core EPS without price denominator to reduce direct EPS-yield cloning.

name: v22_implied_option_expense_clean
hypothesis: Lower implied option expense may indicate cleaner core earnings and less employee-option dilution.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_xintopt) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newqv1300_spcep12 / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Option-expense accounting adjustment; distinct from market option skew active.

name: v22_guidance_core_composite
hypothesis: Combine management guidance visibility with core earnings cleanliness while keeping each component moderate to avoid cloning existing value/quality alphas.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(max_ebitda_guidance - min_ebitda_guidance) / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newqv1300_spcep12 / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_pncepsq), 126), industry)
notes: Crossover only; submit only if it clears correlation to analyst/value actives.
